notes.title: Major White Sands Update
notes.content:
Dear All,


We have just released the next major update to White Sands.
Thank you for your patience and support.


The list of features and changes has been divided into 3 categories. RED, YELLOW and GREEN. Some changes are still work in progress (WIP) so they will continue to improve and expand.


RED

Drone Camera complete overhaul (user has full control over drone movement)

Major mission redesign changes, implementing new types of enemy spawns and interactive buildings and locations.

Constructable defenses and buildings or building add-ons when paired with specialist units.

Click and drag selection of units.

Tutorial text changes and narrator added.

YELLOW

Major location changes, including new unique locations reflecting very specific mission scenarios like capturing The Dam or a Nuclear Power Plant

Mutants performing attacks by jumping and climbing on vehicles and buildings. (WIP)

New enemy unit spawn types:

a) enemy long range vehicle and foot patrols around locations.
b) casualty based enemy spawn waves



GREEN    

Interactive Building improvements such as gun port reaction times, and option to select the entire building as target (WIP). This is implemented but lacks proper UI elements which makes it counterintuitive, therefore note this as still WIP.

New sounds

Unit Health bar

UI changes and improvements, such as adding unit sprites in various UI locations and capacity information.

Mission narration (WIP)


Bug fixes and technical improvements:


 Complete events bug loop fix.
 Behavior improvements and fixes.
 Various unit spawn error fixes.
 Further Unit pathfinding and collision detection improvements.
 Multiple location and terrain fixes resulting in better mission flow and performance.
 Asset poly count optimizations and LOD implementation. (WIP)
 Material and texture size optimizations.




We are looking forward to your feedback.

Respectfully,
Binge Gaming Team

Mission and unit rebalancing

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Due to many players encountering issues which are clearly due to skipping the tutorial, we have decided to temporarily add a short instruction clip to the start of the game explaining how some core mechanics work.

Once we refine the ability to Skip Tutorial and add more proper tutorial tips, this clip will be removed.

Other changes include further difficulty balancing.
New unit for bandits.
Minor mission fixes.
Text fixes.

Some support weapons markers now also show range of the explosion effect.
